# Release Migration Parity

> An AI agent skill for preserving accepted UI, behavior, and data semantics when releasing an app or migrating it to another platform.

Maintainer: kevin-12-ou
Repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/release-migration-parity
License: MIT
Skill name: release-migration-parity
Version: 1.0.0
Install: npx skills add kevin-12-ou/release-migration-parity --skill release-migration-parity
